exposure: Persistent low-lying placenta vs. resolved low-lying placenta
Women with IOD >10mm allowed to labor
Women with vaginal delivery vs. cesarean delivery within each IOD group
cohort: 86 women with low-lying placenta confirmed at 28-30 weeks sonography between January 2009 and March 2018
finding: Women with low-lying placenta resolved by late third trimester (IOD >10mm) had high chances of vaginal delivery regardless of parity and antepartum bleeding, without increased hemorrhagic risk.
mod_finding: Women with a low-lying placenta that resolved and had a placental edge-to-internal os distance (IOD) >10 mm had high chances of successful vaginal delivery, regardless of parity or antepartum bleeding.
